Remark
[distribution generated by Killing fields]

Source: petersen:page-0344 ↗ prop:pet-ch8-killing-uniqueness 1. ch8:8.4.9Let $(M,g)$ be a Riemannian manifold and $t_p=\{ X|_p\in T_pM\mid X\in \iso \} $.

  1. Show that $t_p$ defines an integrable distribution on an open set $O\subset M$. (Hint: show $\{ p\in M\mid \dim t_p=\max _{q\in M}\dim t_q\} $ is open.)

  2. Give an example where $O\ne M$.

  3. Show that $DF(t_p)=t_{F(p)}$ for all $F\in \mathrm{Iso}(M,g)$.

  4. Assume $(M,g)$ is complete. Show that the leaves of this distribution are homogeneous and properly embedded. (Hint: show the connected subgroup $\mathrm{Iso}_0\subset \mathrm{Iso}(M,g)$ containing the identity is closed and preserves the leaves.)

  5. Show that if $(M,g)$ is homogeneous, then $t_p=T_pM$ for all $p\in M$.
